scenes: What does a simple rest point need?
A site. | Clean water. | Someone to open it. | And money to keep it going. Each belongs to a different body.
Protection reaches a worker only when every one of them holds. | This is a tool for cooperation, not for blame.
Agree who does what, before the hot week.
